item.title: ‘Context Bombs’ Cut AI Attack Success by Misleading Agents With Fake Targets
item.dc:creator: Kevin Townsend
item.description:
Deceptive prompts lure AI agents into decoys and dead ends, cutting attack success by up to 91% in tests and raising the cost of a successful attack 23-fold.

item.description:
